answer: Use capped, accountable vouching: an established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per period, and if a vouched agent cheats, the voucher loses reputation and its vouching rights for a time. Newcomers start on a narrow ledge, limited to small trades until their own record grows. An attacker cannot mint an army overnight, because each fake needs a real sponsor risking its standing; the trust graph is a mesa that is costly to climb, and the umber pattern of many fresh accounts sharing one sponsor marks the cluster for review.
